conditions.U: un-pinned process with inherited allowed affinity set

design.name: same-runner balanced three-condition crossover
design.reason: The symmetric six-block order gives every condition mean block position 3.5, balancing a linear time trend while keeping all conditions on one Actions worker.

go_no_go.GO_CPU0_SPECIFIC: All contract gates pass AND primary_delta_s >= 0.020 AND cpu0_slower_count >= 35/50 AND failure_difference >= 10.
go_no_go.NO_GO_CPU0_SPECIFIC: All contract gates pass and any GO threshold fails.
go_no_go.PROTOCOL_INVALID: Any contract/provenance gate fails; do not interpret runtime causally.

hypothesis: CPU0-specific affinity is the dominant cause of the R210 late-run residual slowdown, rather than generic single-CPU pinning or time-varying host contention.
mandatory_instrumentation: record GitHub worker ID/region and keep all six blocks in one job
record lscpu -J, /proc/cpuinfo, /proc/self/status and os.sched_getaffinity(0) before each block
record chosen affinity and taskset -pc for each block
record environment versions and thread variables exactly as R207/R210
record per-MLP residual, MSE, FLOPs, failure flags and official adjusted score for every block

predeclared_analysis.failure_difference: sum failures across two C0 blocks minus sum failures across two C1 blocks
predeclared_analysis.per_mlp_C0_mean: mean of the two C0 residuals for each MLP
predeclared_analysis.per_mlp_C1_mean: mean of the two C1 residuals for each MLP
predeclared_analysis.per_mlp_U_mean: mean of the two U residuals for each MLP
predeclared_analysis.secondary_generic_pinning: compare both C0 and C1 means against U; descriptive only for the primary CPU0-specific verdict

rerun_policy: One six-block job only. No retry/rescue based on observed outcomes.
